🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: the gh-2461 release-notes entry is deleted from `## Unreleased`**

This PR's CHANGELOG edit replaces the shipped gh-2461 bullet ("identical-tool-call loop guard", merged via #2465) with the new gh-2471 bullet instead of appending alongside it. On `origin/main` the gh-2461 entry sits at `CHANGELOG.md:16` inside `## Unreleased`; on this branch `grep -c "gh-2461" CHANGELOG.md` returns 0 and the text is not relocated to any other markdown file or release section.

`CHANGELOG.md` is curated-only (`## Unreleased`) per AGENTS.md — the release fold consumes `Unreleased` verbatim at the next tag, so merging as-is permanently erases the release-notes record of the gh-2461 fix (which shipped and cut a tag). This is also outside the PR's scope (a ci-red fix needs only its own entry).

**Fix**: re-add the removed gh-2461 bullet (verbatim from `origin/main`'s `## Unreleased`) above the new gh-2471 entry. Two entries, one PR.

The new test title says `rosterSetled` — spelled S-e-t-l-e-d — while the capability it exercises is `rosterSettled` (S-e-t-t-l-e-d, double "t"), as defined by `RosterSettleness.rosterSettled` in `lib/src/messaging/fallback_messaging_repository.dart`. Same typo appears in the sibling test at `test/hub/hub_messaging_repository_test.dart:311`. Cosmetic only — it slightly hurts grep-ability of the new warm-up tests against the capability name.

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The gh-2471 fix is sound and verified locally (clean `dart analyze` on the three touched source files; all 52 tests in the four touched/affected test files pass, including the `dap_fabric_roundtrip` IT whose "hub restart forwards the queue exactly once" leg is the production shape this PR targets). One blocking issue: the CHANGELOG edit deletes the shipped gh-2461 release-notes entry instead of appending below it.

**Key Issues**:
1. 🚨 `CHANGELOG.md:16` — the gh-2461 bullet (`## Unreleased`, present on `origin/main`) is deleted, not relocated. The release fold consumes `Unreleased` verbatim at the next tag, so merging as-is permanently erases gh-2461's release-notes record. Restore it above the new gh-2471 entry.

**Ranked digest** (no thread needed):
- `bin/hub_fabric_repository.dart:125` — `isConnected`/`rosterSettled` getters mutate welcome-witness state and may subscribe a stream (the three-signal restart witness works — attach seed, `isConnected` transition, `welcomeEvents` cover each other's blind spots — but side-effecting getters deserve the reader's caution; already commented inline).
- `bin/hub_fabric_repository.dart:94` — `_welcomeWatchSub` has no teardown path; fine while the adapter is CLI-process-lifetime, worth a cancel hook if a dispose ever appears.
- `lib/src/messaging/fallback_messaging_repository.dart:102` — `_rosterSettled` double-cast; `(_router as RosterSettleness?)?.rosterSettled ?? true` reads cleaner.
- `test/hub/hub_fabric_repository_test.dart:341` + `test/hub/hub_messaging_repository_test.dart:211` — the new `rosterSettled isFalse` assertions lean on ~200–300ms wall-clock slack after the welcome stamp; one-sided flake exposure on loaded runners (the 2-distinct-SHA quarantine is the backstop).

**Next Steps**:
1. Restore the deleted gh-2461 entry in `CHANGELOG.md` (verbatim from `origin/main`).
2. Optionally fix the `rosterSetled` → `rosterSettled` test-title typos (two files, marked NIT).
3. Ticket contract (gh-2471 = ci-red, "closes when the ref goes green"): root cause addressed, regression tests added, touched suites green — mergeable once the changelog entry is restored.
